% Pattern: proof/attach/wrapper. A proof wrapper whose second argument goes
% into the end mark and names what the proof proves, by a reference. The
% proof comes after another statement, so only the argument attaches it.
% Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here labels=main
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 2 status=none
% want proof-1 proof - proves=theorem-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newenvironment{PROOF}[2][\proofname.]
{\begin{proof}[#1]\renewcommand{\qedsymbol}{\textsquare$_{\rm #2}$}}
{\end{proof}}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}\label{main}
A statement.
\end{theorem}
\begin{lemma}
A helper.
\end{lemma}
\begin{PROOF}{\ref{main}}
A step.
\end{PROOF}
\end{document}
